recent.area: ST. THOMAS / ST. JOHN AND ADJACENT ISLANDS
recent.narrative: A frontal boundary and an upper level trough approached the islands early in the month. Total rainfalls from these events ranged from 4 to 5 inches. Therefore, soil and vegetation conditions improved, and the wells monitored by the USGS showed an increase in water as well.

recent.area: ST. THOMAS / ST. JOHN AND ADJACENT ISLANDS
recent.narrative: Severe Long Term Drought (D2) were reported during this period. Ground water levels are below normal, while agricultures are reporting that the lack of waters are affecting poultry and vegetation.

recent.area: ST. THOMAS / ST. JOHN AND ADJACENT ISLANDS
recent.narrative: The lack of rains and dry soils, as well as current impacts to agriculture and vegetation have lead to the continuation of a Severe Drought (D2) across Saint Thomas. Saint John remained free of drought.

recent.area: ST. THOMAS / ST. JOHN AND ADJACENT ISLANDS
recent.narrative: Drought conditions remained unchanged in St. Thomas through the month of November. Some precipitation fell into the islands, and the wells responded accordingly. However, the long term indices still indicate Severe Drought (D2) conditions prevailing.
